description: Defines the WPEFramework Plugin::Probe class and its nested classes for network probing, including WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance, with methods for handling network requests, responses, and broadcasting probe messages.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class for network probing, managing instances, broadcasting, and listening for network requests.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web requests for the probe.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Broadcasts probe messages over the network using UDP datagrams.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a network probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into socket buffer format.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web response based on incoming request.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message via broadcast.
